subject.title: fix(launchd): verify profile updater jobs by metadata

question: Should OpenClaw land this metadata-gated profile-scoped updater classifier now, or require maintainer-run macOS confirmation before merge?
rationale: The code and contributor proof support the fix, but the changed disable/reporting surface can affect managed Gateway availability if metadata matching is wrong.

options.title: Land with metadata-gated proof
options.body: Accept the supplied positive and negative macOS launchd proof plus focused tests and proceed through normal maintainer merge gating.

options.title: Request owner-side macOS confirmation
options.body: Have a maintainer rerun the temporary LaunchAgent proof against the exact head before accepting the availability-sensitive classifier.

options.title: Pause for a narrower policy
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want a different permanent contract for profile-scoped updater labels or explicit updater markers only.

recommendation.title: Land with metadata-gated proof
recommendation.body: Accept the supplied positive and negative macOS launchd proof plus focused tests and proceed through normal maintainer merge gating.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to this account and their history is closest to the stale updater launchd reporting and self-disarm paths.
